note: Curated catalog of skills/agents Hina + agent-router can route to, with install methods CROSS-CHECKED against each repo's README + manifest (2026-06-16) — no assumptions. Used by scripts/hina-bootstrap.js: it derives the marketplace's canonical name from the live manifest, then runs `claude plugin marketplace add <repo>` + `claude plugin install <plugin>@<name>` for each name in the entry's `enable` list, installing ONLY plugins not already in installed_plugins.json. TWO CLASSES: specialist suites are additive (install as many as you like); MEMORY is exactly ONE, backend-only (claude-mem), never run alongside Hina's own memory. install_method: marketplace | npm | npm-proxy | setup-script. `enable` = curated plugin names (verified) the auto-installer enables; absent/empty = register marketplace only.

entries.name: ecc
entries.title: ECC (Every Commit Counts)
entries.why: VERIFIED: single plugin `ecc@ecc` bundles 67 agents + 271 skills. Install: `claude plugin marketplace add affaan-m/ECC` + `claude plugin install ecc@ecc`. (README shows the /plugin slash form; CLI equivalent used by the installer.)

entries.name: ruflo
entries.title: Ruflo
entries.why: VERIFIED: 33 plugins; base is `ruflo-core@ruflo`. Curated enable = core (reviewer), testgen (testing), security-audit (security), goals (research). Full Path-A CLI/MCP details in README; `enable` lists the curated subset, not all 33.

entries.name: wshobson-agents
entries.title: wshobson/agents
entries.why: VERIFIED: 84 plugins. CRITICAL — repo slug is `wshobson/agents` but the marketplace NAME is `claude-code-workflows` (install keys are `<plugin>@claude-code-workflows`). The installer derives this from the manifest automatically. Curated enable covers review/test/security/debug/docs.

entries.name: voltagent-subagents
entries.title: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents
entries.why: VERIFIED + INSTALLED LIVE: 10 capability-bundle plugins (154 subagents). Install: `claude plugin marketplace add VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents` + `claude plugin install <name>@voltagent-subagents`.

entries.name: claude-plugins-official
entries.title: Anthropic official plugins
entries.why: VERIFIED name `claude-plugins-official` (227 plugins). BUT the `marketplace add <slug>` step is NOT documented — it ships PRE-REGISTERED with Claude Code (local copy sourced from GCS, no git remote). `verify:true` so the installer does NOT try to add it by slug. Install specific plugins with `claude plugin install <plugin>@claude-plugins-official` if desired.

entries.name: marketingskills
entries.title: marketingskills
entries.why: VERIFIED: marketplace name `marketingskills` (no hyphen), single plugin `marketing-skills` (WITH hyphen) = 40 marketing skills. Repo's preferred install is `npx skills add coreyhaines31/marketingskills`; marketplace form is `claude plugin install marketing-skills@marketingskills`. Optional (marketing/GTM).

entries.name: gstack
entries.title: gstack
entries.why: VERIFIED: skills suite (/browse, /office-hours, /plan-ceo-review). NOT a marketplace plugin and NOT on npm — installed by git-cloning into ~/.claude/skills/gstack and running ./setup. The auto-installer reports this as manual (it only auto-runs marketplace installs); run the install_command yourself.

entries.name: claude-mem
entries.title: claude-mem
entries.why: VERIFIED: npm `claude-mem` (repo thedotmack/claude-mem), the single memory entry / backend-adoption candidate. Install with `npx claude-mem install` (NOT `npm i -g claude-mem`, which skips the hooks + worker). Installs hooks + a background worker. Do NOT run alongside Hina's own file memory; adopt via an adapter.

entries.name: claude-code-router
entries.title: Claude Code Router
entries.why: VERIFIED: npm `@musistudio/claude-code-router` (repo musistudio/claude-code-router), CLI `ccr`. SEPARATE INFRASTRUCTURE — a proxy that reroutes Claude Code to other model providers (DIFFERENT problem from skill routing). HIGH risk: changes how Claude Code connects to models. Requires Claude Code installed first; run via `ccr code`. Cataloged for awareness, not default install.
